LanguageData.Skill_BerserkerChaos.label: Berserker Chaos
LanguageData.Skill_BerserkerChaos.description: Always active:\nthe more badly wounded this person is, the higher their melee damage.
LanguageData.Skill_Provoke.label: Provoke
LanguageData.Skill_Provoke.description: Can be used while drafted:\nmakes enemies in a large area around this person target them instead, for several hours.
LanguageData.Skill_DesperateArmyWin.label: Desperate Army's Victory
LanguageData.Skill_DesperateArmyWin.description: Always active while mood is low:\ngains large bonuses to strength, endurance, agility and will, scaled to how low the mood is.
LanguageData.Skill_RoundhouseKick.label: Roundhouse Kick
LanguageData.Skill_RoundhouseKick.description: Deals unarmed damage to a single enemy within a short distance and knocks them back hard.\nIf the knockback path is blocked, deals heavy additional damage. Can store several charges.
LanguageData.Skill_SwordRain.label: Sword Rain
LanguageData.Skill_SwordRain.description: Requires a melee weapon (sharp).\nStrikes enemies in a small area around this person with two weapon hits.\nA kill or a knocked-down enemy immediately resets the cooldown, but only a limited number of times.
LanguageData.Skill_FlameAffinity.label: Flame Affinity
LanguageData.Skill_FlameAffinity.description: Always active:\ngreatly increases heat armor and maximum comfortable temperature,\nincreases flammability, removes any fear of fire, and continuously heals injuries while burning.
LanguageData.Skill_LanceCharge.label: Lance Charge
LanguageData.Skill_LanceCharge.description: Requires a melee weapon (sharp).\nDashes toward a target point within a moderate distance, dealing heavy damage to enemies along the path and knocking them back.
LanguageData.Skill_ManaLoad.label: Mana Load
LanguageData.Skill_ManaLoad.description: Triggers when spending mana:\ngrants bonuses to attack mana control and strength based on the mana spent so far.\nThe effect lasts several hours, and spending mana again during it resets the duration.
LanguageData.Skill_Ember.label: Ember
LanguageData.Skill_Ember.description: Triggers when knocked down:\nforces this person to stay alive for a short time and rapidly repair their injuries, then forces them into a coma.
LanguageData.Skill_IaiSpiritSlash.label: Iai Spirit Slash
LanguageData.Skill_IaiSpiritSlash.description: Requires a melee weapon (sharp).\nEnters an iai stance, taking all incoming damage into the blade.\nAfter a moment, draws and flashes a short distance in the chosen direction, dealing weapon damage to enemies along the path plus a portion of the damage absorbed.
LanguageData.Skill_Railgun.label: Railgun
LanguageData.Skill_Railgun.description: Requires a ranged weapon.\nCharges the weapon with electromagnetic energy: the next several shots pierce along the bullet path, dealing heavy damage and briefly stunning enemies.\nWalls stop the shot but take piercing damage.
LanguageData.Skill_2FightIs2Be.label: I Fight, Therefore I Am
LanguageData.Skill_2FightIs2Be.description: Triggers when entering combat:\nall abilities rise the longer the fight goes on, rest and nutrition consumption are reduced and mental resistance is increased;\nthe effect ends a while after leaving combat.
